entries.effect: every message of the list, in order: a type 1 system message as its MIDI 1.0 bytes; a type 2 word as written; a type 3 SysEx7 packet run joined into one complete F0 ... F7 message sent to MusicDeviceSysEx; a type 4 MIDI 2.0 channel voice message converted to MIDI 1.0 (note on velocity max(1, velocity16 >> 9), controller and pitch bend scalings measured bit for bit on the host's sampler; note off, pressures and program change by the UMP rule, which the sampler does not show); other types are not sent
